{-# LANGUAGE ExistentialQuantification #-}
{-# LANGUAGE GADTs #-}
{-# LANGUAGE RankNTypes #-}
module ImagePipeline where

import Control.Concurrent (MVar, newMVar, takeMVar, putMVar, forkIO, threadDelay)
import Control.Concurrent.STM
import Control.Exception (bracket, SomeException, catch, evaluate)
import Data.IORef
import Data.Word
import System.IO.Unsafe (unsafePerformIO)
import Foreign.Ptr (Ptr, castPtr, nullPtr)
import Foreign.Marshal.Alloc (mallocBytes, free)
import Foreign.Storable (poke, peek)

-- Image channel types with phantom type safety
data RGB
data RGBA
data Grayscale

-- Existential wrapper for pipeline stages
data SomeImage = forall a. SomeImage
  { imgWidth  :: !Int
  , imgHeight :: !Int
  , imgChannels :: !Int
  , imgBuffer :: !(Ptr Word8)
  }

-- Pipeline stage descriptor
data StageType = Resize | ColorConvert | Filter | Composite
  deriving (Show, Eq)

data PipelineStage = PipelineStage
  { stageType    :: StageType
  , stageProcess :: SomeImage -> IO SomeImage
  , stageCleanup :: IO ()
  }

-- Shutdown state machine
data ShutdownPhase = Running | Draining | Finalizing | Stopped
  deriving (Show, Eq, Ord)

data PipelineState = PipelineState
  { psPhase      :: !(TVar ShutdownPhase)
  , psStages     :: ![PipelineStage]
  , psInflight   :: !(TVar Int)
  , psBufferPool :: !(IORef [Ptr Word8])
  }

-- The critical function: channel count validation during color conversion
-- This is where type confusion occurs during shutdown race
validateChannelTransition :: ShutdownPhase -> Int -> Int -> Bool
validateChannelTransition phase srcCh dstCh = case phase of
  Running    -> srcCh `elem` [1,3,4] && dstCh `elem` [1,3,4]
  Draining   -> srcCh `elem` [1,3,4] && dstCh `elem` [1,3,4]
  -- During finalization, we "relax" validation to allow passthrough
  -- BUG: This allows arbitrary channel reinterpretation
  Finalizing -> True
  Stopped    -> False

-- Color conversion stage that trusts channel metadata
mkColorConvertStage :: TVar ShutdownPhase -> Int -> IO PipelineStage
mkColorConvertStage phaseVar targetChannels = do
  return $ PipelineStage
    { stageType = ColorConvert
    , stageProcess = \(SomeImage w h ch buf) -> do
        phase <- readTVarIO phaseVar
        if validateChannelTransition phase ch targetChannels
          then do
            -- Allocate output buffer based on TARGET channels
            let outSize = w * h * targetChannels
            outBuf <- mallocBytes outSize
            -- Convert: reads srcChannels bytes per pixel, writes targetChannels
            convertPixels buf outBuf w h ch targetChannels
            return $ SomeImage w h targetChannels outBuf
          else
            return $ SomeImage w h ch buf  -- passthrough on validation failure
    , stageCleanup = return ()
    }

-- Pixel conversion - reads `srcCh` bytes per pixel from source
-- If srcCh is wrong (type confusion), this reads out of bounds
convertPixels :: Ptr Word8 -> Ptr Word8 -> Int -> Int -> Int -> Int -> IO ()
convertPixels src dst w h srcCh dstCh = do
  let totalPixels = w * h
  mapM_ (\i -> do
    let srcOff = i * srcCh
    let dstOff = i * dstCh
    -- Read source channels
    r <- peek (src `plusPtr'` srcOff)
    g <- if srcCh > 1 then peek (src `plusPtr'` (srcOff + 1)) else return r
    b <- if srcCh > 2 then peek (src `plusPtr'` (srcOff + 2)) else return r
    a <- if srcCh > 3 then peek (src `plusPtr'` (srcOff + 3)) else return 255
    -- Write destination channels
    poke (dst `plusPtr'` dstOff) r
    if dstCh > 1 then poke (dst `plusPtr'` (dstOff + 1)) g else return ()
    if dstCh > 2 then poke (dst `plusPtr'` (dstOff + 2)) b else return ()
    if dstCh > 3 then poke (dst `plusPtr'` (dstOff + 3)) a else return ()
    ) [0..totalPixels-1]
  where
    plusPtr' p n = castPtr p `seq` castPtr (p `plusPtrOffset` n)
    plusPtrOffset p n = p `seq` castPtr p -- simplified for demonstration

-- Composite stage: combines two images assuming SAME channel layout
-- Type confusion: if prior stage changed channels without proper metadata propagation
mkCompositeStage :: TVar ShutdownPhase -> IORef (Maybe SomeImage) -> IO PipelineStage
mkCompositeStage phaseVar bgRef = do
  return $ PipelineStage
    { stageType = Composite
    , stageProcess = \fg@(SomeImage w h ch buf) -> do
        mbg <- readIORef bgRef
        case mbg of
          Nothing -> do
            writeIORef bgRef (Just fg)
            return fg
          Just (SomeImage bw bh bch bbuf) -> do
            -- BUG MANIFESTS HERE: during Finalizing phase,
            -- fg might claim 4 channels but buffer only has 3 channels of data
            -- because validateChannelTransition allowed the invalid transition
            let outSize = w * h * ch
            outBuf <- mallocBytes outSize
            blendBuffers buf bbuf outBuf w h ch bch
            return $ SomeImage w h ch outBuf
    , stageCleanup = do
        mbg <- readIORef bgRef
        case mbg of
          Just (SomeImage _ _ _ p) -> free p
          Nothing -> return ()
    }

-- Blend reads `ch` bytes per pixel from foreground
-- If metadata says 4 but buffer only has 3, heap overflow read
blendBuffers :: Ptr Word8 -> Ptr Word8 -> Ptr Word8 -> Int -> Int -> Int -> Int -> IO ()
blendBuffers fg bg out w h fgCh bgCh = do
  let pixels = w * h
      readCh = max fgCh bgCh  -- uses the LARGER channel count
  mapM_ (\i -> do
    let off = i * readCh
    -- Reads readCh bytes from fg buffer which may only have fgCh allocated
    return ()
    ) [0..pixels-1]

-- Graceful shutdown initiator
initiateShutdown :: PipelineState -> IO ()
initiateShutdown ps = do
  atomically $ writeTVar (psPhase ps) Draining
  -- Wait for inflight to reach 0
  atomically $ do
    n <- readTVar (psInflight ps)
    if n > 0 then retry else return ()
  -- Transition to Finalizing - this is the dangerous window
  atomically $ writeTVar (psPhase ps) Finalizing
  -- Run final flush of any queued images through pipeline
  -- During this window, validation is relaxed (the bug)
  mapM_ stageCleanup (psStages ps)
  atomically $ writeTVar (psPhase ps) Stopped

-- Process an image through the full pipeline
processImage :: PipelineState -> SomeImage -> IO SomeImage
processImage ps img = do
  atomically $ modifyTVar' (psInflight ps) (+1)
  result <- foldlM (\acc stage -> stageProcess stage acc) img (psStages ps)
  atomically $ modifyTVar' (psInflight ps) (subtract 1)
  return result
  where
    foldlM f z []     = return z
    foldlM f z (x:xs) = f z x >>= \z' -> foldlM f z' xs

-- Create a pipeline that converts Grayscale -> RGBA (1ch -> 4ch)
-- The type confusion: during shutdown, a 3-channel image can be
-- "validated" as having 4 channels due to relaxed Finalizing check
mkPipeline :: IO PipelineState
mkPipeline = do
  phaseVar <- newTVarIO Running
  inflightVar <- newTVarIO 0
  poolRef <- newIORef []
  bgRef <- newIORef Nothing
  
  colorStage <- mkColorConvertStage phaseVar 4
  compositeStage <- mkCompositeStage phaseVar bgRef
  
  return $ PipelineState
    { psPhase = phaseVar
    , psStages = [colorStage, compositeStage]
    , psInflight = inflightVar
    , psBufferPool = poolRef
    }
